current_title: P-comp: MECH-448 demotion x MECH-449 Go/No-Go composition at PER-COMMITMENT committed-class entropy (2x2 diagnostic; 699 instrument repair -- fresh-select DV, levers_compound withdrawn)
recent_lines: anchor_note: fresh_e3_selection_sufficiency_all_arms is UNGUARDED -- no frozen reference exists, because V3-EXQ-699 recorded NO fresh-selection count at all. floor=100 genuine E3 selections per cell; P2=60 ep x 200 steps = 12000 env steps per cell IF episodes run to full length (they do not -- CausalGridWorldV2 ends an episode on death, and 699's recorded P2 env-step counts ranged 461..12000).

n_p2_ticks/10 is a reasonable SCALE for the fresh-selection count but is a slight UNDER-estimate, not an upper bound. E3 firing is EVENT-DRIVEN: heartbeat/clock.py advance() fires an E3 tick IMMEDIATELY on a pending phase reset (a salient event) and resets the phase counter, and agent.py:5430 also runs select() on a non-E3 tick whenever _last_action is None (so an episode RESET buys a free selection). e3_steps_per_tick=10 is therefore the MAXIMUM interval between ticks. Measured on a real full-scale run, V3-EXQ-785a recorded fresh_select_yield 0.111 / 0.143 / 0.111 across its arms -- just above 1/10, consistent with that.

DO NOT calibrate this from a --dry-run. Short DRY_RUN_STEPS episodes end in ~10-17 ticks and E3 fires near episode start, so toy yields run 0.5-1.0 and OVERSTATE the real value by 4-8x (independently observed in the V3-EXQ-707c smoke, 0.67-1.00).

ONE EFFECT THAT IS NOT QUANTIFIED, and which this run settles: because an episode reset yields a free selection, a DEATH-PRONE cell running many SHORT episodes gets a higher yield than a long-surviving one. That partially COMPENSATES the survival-driven spread in sample size (on 699's seed 44 the raw P2-tick ratio between ARM_DEM and ARM_GNG is ~3.8x, but if every one of the 60 P2 episodes contributes a free selection the N ratio falls to ~2.2x). Whether the residual spread matters against COMPOSITION_LIFT_MARGIN=0.05 is exactly what the emitted per-cell counts below decide.

That is exactly why n_fresh_select / n_latched / fresh_select_yield / replication_factor are emitted per arm-seed here: the factor is MEASURED for the first time rather than inferred. Read those fields before drawing any conclusion about sample adequacy. Treat a C1(g) substrate_not_ready_requeue as an instrument-scale finding, not a substrate verdict.
